# has rights statement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasRightsStatement`](gmeow-hasRightsStatement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRightsStatement>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity (typically a [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) or [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md)) to a machine-readable rights statement that governs it — the GMEOW analogue of [odrl:hasPolicy.](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/hasPolicy.)

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasRightsStatement`](gmeow-hasRightsStatement.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Licensed Dataset

- **Source:** [`slices/core/rights/examples/licensed-dataset.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/rights/examples/licensed-dataset.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-rights-examples-licensed-dataset)#example-slices-core-rights-examples-licensed-dataset

```turtle
# --- The asset, with the FLAT-first rights edges (the common case) plus a
#     promoted RightsStatement because permissions/prohibitions/duties are needed.
ex:dataset a gmeow:Dataset ;
    gmeow:title "Coastal Bird Survey 2026"@en ;
    gmeow:hasCopyright       ex:copyright ;
    gmeow:hasLicense         ex:ccbync ;
    gmeow:hasRightsStatement ex:rights .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a reified [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) to the asset it governs when permissions, prohibitions, or duties are expressed; the rights-bearing analogue of [odrl:hasPolicy.](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/hasPolicy.)

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the flat case (an asset that simply bears a licence or copyright — use [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md) / [`gmeow:hasCopyright`](gmeow-hasCopyright.md)) and avoid pointing it at anything but the governed asset; the inverse direction is [`gmeow:statementAbout`](gmeow-statementAbout.md).

### How to use

- Assert one [`gmeow:hasRightsStatement`](gmeow-hasRightsStatement.md) per governing statement; mirror it on the relator with [`gmeow:statementAbout`](gmeow-statementAbout.md) so the statement is self-contained.
